response: Saved Views is available today, giving every user a faster way to work with lists that matter most. Instead of rebuilding filters and sort orders each time, you can now save any configuration as a named view and return to it in one click. Each user can save up to 50 views, covering personal workflows, client work, or recurring reports. Views can also be shared with your team, so everyone works from the same filtered perspective without repeating setup steps. Whether you're tracking overdue tasks, sorting by priority, or grouping by assignee, Saved Views keeps your preferred layout ready whenever you need it. This feature is included in all paid plans at no additional cost, so there's nothing new to purchase or activate. We built Saved Views based on direct customer feedback about repetitive setup work, and we think it will make daily project management noticeably smoother. Give it a try on your busiest list today. Open any list and select Save view to get started.
